chapters.caption: Thirteen parts on a 60 x 60 mm plate
Laser assignment off: one laser exposes all parts
Open Profile › Docs demo (also the platform profile)
Platform Parameter › Scanner array and Laser assignment
2 x 2 scanners with 80 mm scan fields: every laser reaches the whole plate
Strategy 'Swimlane': every part goes whole to one laser
Swimlane width 60 mm: one lane, so all parts are shared in one go
Rebuilt: the parts are shared out, each laser gets about a quarter of the work
Toolpaths in 3D up to layer 25, coloured by laser
